title: Assigning an object makes a copy
statement: Assigning one object variable to another makes a second, independent copy of the object, so changing one does not affect the other.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: trace a mutation through an aliased object
evidence_patterns.signature: reports the other variable's object as unchanged

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across items with mutable objects, and the learner is surprised by the result. A slip is a single wrong trace.

vs.prog.obj.variables-hold-objects: Same observable error; variables-hold-objects is the underlying model (the variable is the object). Ask the learner to draw a and b: two boxes with contents versus two arrows to one object.
vs.prog.var.assignment-links-variables: The primitive mirror image. Test with an int item and a list item.

conflicts_with.label: An object variable holds a reference; assignment copies the reference

resolved_by.label: An object variable holds a reference; assignment copies the reference
